head: feature/clean-look-billing-stage1
title: Draft: preserve Billing workspace and cash closing presentation slice
body:
Preserves the previously reviewed bounded Billing workspace and daily cash closing restyle: semantic surfaces, spacing and36px desktop/44px mobile controls, including payment fields and Add Payment. Both page script blocks remain unchanged; no financial behavior, permission or migration changes.

One existing DD29 desktop-height assertion changed with explicit owner approval on26November2026. Focused126 tests, scoped lint/format, combined preview types/build and synthetic visual/payment-dialog measurements passed at the recorded revision. These are bounded historical gates, not a fresh full gate against latest main.

Owner now requested all existing changes be committed and retained as drafts before handover. This slice is based on older main23639679e and requires latest-main reconciliation/CI before merge. No merge performed.

The owner subsequently clarified that full demo content/layout/interactions must match. This palette/control slice is NOT full makeover completion. The separate collect/close composition draft overlaps CashClosings.vue and must be reconciled without losing either approved behavior or the new content layout.

Evidence: docs/teams/billing/CLEAN-LOOK-STAGE1-PLAN.md; local /workspace/kpone-validation/billing-cl1/ and billing-cl1-independent-review.md. Excludes synthetic fixtures/screenshots/build outputs from the commit.
